newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - PairGain Tech slips.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - PairGain Tech slips.

text.p: PairGain Technologies shares edged down a sliver in after-hours trading Wednesday on second quarter results that were slightly below expectations, traders said.
Dealers said the electronics products company traded at 17-7/8, under an unofficial close of 18-1/4.
PairGain posted a quarterly performance of $0.16 per share after the bell, compared with $0.10 per share for the year-ago period.
According to First Call, however, analysts estimated the company's earnings would rise to $0.18 per share.
Elsewhere, several companies released warnings about their quarterly performances in the run-up to earnings period.
APACHE Medical Systems Inc was halted after hours while it released less-than-stellar expectations for its second quarter revenues.
The healthcare informations systems company said it would post a merger-related charge and that its revenues, listed as $2.8 million for the year-ago period, would miss analysts' expectations.
Also halted after hours was Seagate Technology Inc. Seagate posted fourth quater diluted earnings of $0.61 per share, compared with $0.42.
While most stocks traded very closely in line with their closing prices, dealers said trading was active.
"We still have some things that are rolling along," one trader said.
Compaq Computer, for example, traded at 121, a smidgen below its 121-1/8 close. The PC maker is due to release its widely anticipated earnings results on Thursday.

Also in the PC industry, Apple Computer Inc said late in the day that its chief executive, Gilbert Amelio, had resigned after struggling for more than a year to return the company to profitability. Apple stocks were halted in after-hours trade.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 24,800, compared with 386,500 the previous day. Session two volume fell to 3,061,187 from 5,441,540.
